posts.title: TIL: Dim too-bright pages with a Tampermonkey overlay
posts.description: I run macOS, every app, and every website in dark mode. But plenty of sites ignore prefers-color-scheme and stay blinding white — or ship a dark theme that still leaves one giant white panel. So I wrote a Tampermonkey userscript that drops a translucent dark layer over near-white pages, with macOS-style hotkeys to nudge the brightness. posts.title: TIL: Where iTerm2 stores its ANSI colors
posts.description: I wanted to review my iTerm2 color scheme from the command line instead of squinting at swatches in the settings UI. The colors live in the prefs plist, under the New Bookmarks array — one dict per profile: ~/Library/Preferences/com.googlecode.iterm2.plist Each color is a dict of float components (0–1), not hex.
